title: KGAP: Knowledge Graph Augmented Political Perspective Detection in News Media

bias_targets.methodology: Graph-level classification of news articles into political perspectives (e.g., left, center, right, or hyperpartisan) using a Knowledge Graph Augmented method (KGAP). The approach models news articles as heterogeneous information networks, combining textual content encoded by language models with external structural knowledge from a custom political knowledge graph, and applies relational graph neural networks (gated R-GCN) to predict the stance.
